info.title: Radio Monitoring System
info.description:
Radio monitoring API. Every API version has its own OpenAPI document, generated from the code, errors included,
with Swagger UI and ReDoc next to it: `/api/v1/openapi.json`, `/api/v1/docs`,
`/api/v1/redoc`.

## Authentication
`Authorization: Bearer <access token>` from `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. A 401 with `invalid_token` means:
refresh with `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`; any other 401 code (`session_expired` included: the session
ended) means: log in again. A session lives while it is used and is bound to the client certificate it was
opened with.

## Errors (RFC 9457 Problem Details)
Every error answers `Content-Type: application/problem+json`:

| member | meaning |
|---|---|
| `type` | URI of the problem type; open it for its documentation (`/problems/<code>`) |
| `title` | fixed summary of the problem type |
| `status` | HTTP status code |
| `detail` | English text of this occurrence |
| `instance` | path of the request that failed |
| `code` | **localization key** of exactly this message (never a category) |
| other members | params of the message (`post_id`, `offset`, `max_file_size_bytes`, ...) |

Each response of each operation lists the problem types it can answer (`oneOf`, discriminator `code`).
Each problem type is a component schema `<Code>Problem` (`PostNotFoundProblem`); `/problems` documents them all.

`validation_error` (422) carries `errors`: one item per invalid value with `code`, `detail` and either
`pointer` (JSON Pointer into the body, `#/username`) or `parameter` + `location` (query, path, header, cookie).
Item codes are `components.schemas.FieldErrorCode` plus pydantic's codes (`missing`, `string_too_short`, ...).

## Typed client
`npx openapi-typescript <origin>/api/v1/openapi.json -o src/api/schema.ts` generates the types of v1;
operation ids are the endpoint names (`update_post`).

patch.description:
Update user fields - all fields are optional

Supports updating:
- username: Unique username (3-50 characters)
- username_alias: User's display name (1-255 characters)
- post_id: User's post/position ID
- is_active: User's active status (boolean)
- role_ids: Replace all user roles, one form field per role (role_ids=1&role_ids=2)
- certificate: Update PKI certificate authentication data (file upload). A different certificate ends every
  session of the user, like deactivation: the old certificate's tokens stop working.

Only provided fields will be updated. Archived users answer 404 until restored (POST /{user_id}/restore).
The fields are form fields: any other body (JSON included) answers 415 instead of being ignored.

Changing another user needs a user who holds no permission the caller lacks (403
target_user_more_privileged), new roles only permissions the caller holds (403
grant_exceeds_own_permissions). A role change or a deactivation must leave an active administrator and the
caller's own admin.true (409 last_admin_required, cannot_remove_own_admin).

delete.description:
PERMANENTLY delete a role. This is the only hard delete in the API and cannot be undone.

Requires role.delete (distinct from role.archive). The role row, its permission grants and its
assignments to archived users are removed from the database. Preconditions, each answered with 409:
the role must be archived first (POST /{role_id}/archive), no active user may still hold it
(the response lists them), and the built-in admin role can never be deleted.
The audit log keeps a full copy of the role, its permissions and its assignments.

- By specific observation IDs

- By user IDs (one or many)
- By post IDs (one or many)
- By signal type IDs

- Any combination of the above
